title: Palantir depth-4 contracts, ethics and portfolio assessment
summary: Depth-4 synthesis resolving concrete awards, disclosure controls, Rockbridge legal structure and first-generation 1789 portfolio benefits.

sources.title: Tech donor network co-founded by JD Vance seeks to push America to the right
Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment

data.question: What appears at depth 4 when the Palantir–Thiel–Vance–Trump graph is expanded through the queued IRS, ethics, Rockbridge and 1789 portfolio targets?
data.method: Award-ID reconciliation, current-role verification, public financial-disclosure review, legal-entity disambiguation and portfolio-to-government benefit mapping.
data.framework: contract execution + technology authority + ethics controls + organizational structure + portfolio benefits
data.scope: Depth 4 only; unresolved causal, technical and ownership questions are queued for depth 5.
findings: The reported IRS mega-API concept became a named $14.244 million Unified API contract with a semantic layer for enterprise data access.
Four reconciled IRS Palantir orders in this pass total $45,956,895.56 in current obligated amounts; this is not Palantir's complete IRS revenue or total IRS contract exposure.
Clark Minor disclosed and sold $1 million–$5 million of PLTR on July 9, 2025.
Gregory Barbaccia disclosed $1,001–$15,000 of PLTR; current disposition and recusal status remain unresolved.
Rockbridge donor outreach is reported to operate through a distinct for-profit Delaware LLC.
1789-backed portfolio companies received or announced defense contracts, while Vulcan received a $620 million conditional commitment that must not be treated as a disbursed outlay.
conclusions: Depth 4 converts several prior reporting leads into award-level and disclosure-level records.
The strongest open questions concern implementation controls, recusals, beneficial ownership and award chronology rather than whether the entities or awards exist.
counterarguments: Full-and-open fair-opportunity designations weaken claims that the IRS orders were facially sole-source favors.
Officials may comply fully with ethics rules despite prior employment or disclosed holdings.
Portfolio companies may have won awards on technical merit independent of political connections.
A conditional loan commitment is not proof of disbursement or improper influence.
limitations: Unified API statement of work and privacy documentation were not publicly resolved.
Official ethics agreements and recusal determinations were not located for every official.
Rockbridge Network LLC ownership and intercompany transactions remain opaque.
Some 1789 portfolio relations rely on congressional oversight descriptions pending primary investment records.
unresolved: Unified API data-access and audit-control ledger

caveats: Association and temporal sequence are not causation.
